title: Kolding School Anchor — HANSENBERG Designia / Mediegrafiker
status: institution/programme identified; housing and internship sequence strengthened; exact enrollment year unresolved
subject: Thomas / the Son

identity.correction: The biographical school was HANSENBERG Designia and the programme was mediegrafiker, not Designskolen Kolding at Ågade 10.

direct_recollection_2026_09_12.school_identification: When shown the recovered Designia/HANSENBERG identification, the user confirmed that this was the school.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.programme_identification: The user identifies the programme as mediegrafiker.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.admission_task: To apply, Thomas remembers being given a creative test using coloured cardstock/paper to construct a collage-style circus poster. He assembled the physical poster and mailed it to the school, after which he was accepted.
academic_performance: A in Microsoft Office / Excel / Word
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.performance_interpretation: The education was not remembered as academically difficult. Thomas remembers being competent at the work; later withdrawal was associated with boredom, the draining office/cubicle environment and disillusionment with that career path rather than inability to perform the coursework.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.egypt_relative_to_louise: Thomas and Louise were already together when the Egypt trip occurred.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.internship_relative_to_louise: Thomas and Louise were still together during the draining office/cubicle internship.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.housing_before_internship: Before the internship move, Thomas remembers living with Louise and her parents.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.aabenraa_move: Thomas moved to Aabenraa to be closer to the internship while continuing the relationship and commuting to and from Louise.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.post_school_housing: After the school/internship path failed or ended, Thomas remembers moving into his own place while the relationship with Louise continued for at least some period afterward.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.uncertainty_note: The exact ordering between school failure, internship ending, and the later breakup remains partly remembered and should not be over-specified yet.

public_historical_evidence.evidence: HANSENBERG's institutional history records the 2007 HANSENBERG name change and operation through five branch schools, providing historical context for Designia as a branch-school identity in the relevant period.
HANSENBERG's institutional history confirms active EUD provision in the relevant period. This establishes institutional continuity but does not identify Thomas personally.

A surviving HANSENBERG course listing explicitly names 'designia afd. for medie og grafik' at C.F. Tietgensvej 11 and describes mediegrafiker/grafisk tekniker work, graphical software, photo processing, image/text, and print/electronic communication.
HANSENBERG material from the period lists Designia offerings including mediegrafiker, grafisk tekniker, webintegrator and multimedia-related education.

chronology_effect.known_order: painter → meatpacking → job search → Copenhagen interview → hired on the spot → rapid move to Copenhagen → firing → return to Haderslev → nursing home → own Haderslev apartment → Designia/mediegrafiker application via mailed circus-poster test → acceptance → summer move to Kolding/dormitory → driver's licence in Kolding → Louise relationship → at some point living with Louise and her parents → Egypt while together → move to Aabenraa for internship while maintaining/commuting to relationship → school/internship path fails or ends → own place while relationship continues for some time → later breakup → 2011 Tree corridor
chronology_effect.egypt_constraint: Egypt is constrained to after meeting Louise. It may have occurred before or after the Aabenraa internship move; that ordering is still unresolved.
chronology_effect.internship_constraint: The office/cubicle internship occurred while Thomas and Louise were still together and was geographically important enough to motivate a move to Aabenraa.
chronology_effect.relationship_constraint: The relationship did not end merely because Thomas moved to Aabenraa or because the school/internship path failed; recollection places some continued relationship afterward.
chronology_effect.date_constraint: Designia and mediegrafiker were operating in the relevant 2008–2010 period. The exact personal intake year remains unresolved.

highest_value_remaining_questions: Did the Egypt trip happen before or after Thomas moved to Aabenraa for the internship?
Was the Aabenraa office/cubicle placement a formal Designia mediegrafiker praktik placement?
After the school/internship path failed, was Thomas's own apartment in Aabenraa, Kolding, Haderslev, or somewhere else?
do_not_infer: Do not equate HANSENBERG Designia with Designskolen Kolding.
Do not fix enrollment to 2008 or 2009 solely because Designia existed in both years.
Do not treat office/cubicle dissatisfaction as evidence of academic failure.
Do not place Egypt before Kolding or before Louise.
Do not place the breakup at the Aabenraa move or exactly at school failure; the relationship continued afterward according to current recollection.
Do not infer the post-school apartment's city until recalled or documented.
